title: Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL)
summary: Defines the Simple Authentication and Security Layer, a framework for authentication and data security in connection-oriented protocols through replaceable mechanisms. It lets new protocols reuse existing mechanisms and old protocols adopt new ones. It obsoletes RFC 2222 and is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Different apps need to check who you are. SASL is a standard plug socket so any app can use any login method.
